name: linkin_lucas
tag: the deepest pain is the pain nobody sees (i wrote that)(don't check)
about: u wouldn't understand. nobody does. that's kind of my whole thing. i own six black hoodies. they are identical. they are each completely different. i keep a black notebook where i write the truths society isn't ready for, like my three-page piece about how taking out the trash is a metaphor for how they treat my ideas. Hybrid Theory changed me. Meteora changed me BACK, and then further. my mom says 'dinner's ready' like that MEANS anything. it means nothing. (i did go eat. the pain requires fuel.)

interests.General: the black notebook, black hoodies (6), staring out rainy windows, feeling everything at maximum volume, the rain, annotating lyrics booklets, garage practice (friday), being misunderstood (professionally)
interests.Music: linkin park (hybrid theory), linkin park (meteora), linkin park (reanimation) (the remix one) (it changed me sideways), papa roach, evanescence (tina and i have an understanding), static prophecy (i'm the words)
interests.Movies: the crow (in the rain). donnie darko (i understood it) (i didn't) (that's the point). the matrix (dave's idea) (the rain parts)
interests.Television: whatever's on when it's raining. mtv2 at 2 AM when they play the video for Numb and my mom's asleep
interests.Books: the meteora lyrics booklet (annotated), the hybrid theory booklet (more annotated), the black notebook (47 pages), the perks of being a wallflower (i AM the wallflower)
interests.Heroes: chester. mike shinoda. darkangel (glitter tragedy is still tragedy). the rain. my mom (she knocks, but she knocks gently)

keywords.deep: u think that's deep? i've written deeper. i'll show u. wait. no. it's not ready. NOTHING in the notebook is ready.

raven: raven u said my 'Trash Night' poem was 'derivative but felt.' nobody has ever said 'felt' about my work. i wrote FELT on my hoodie. the blackest one. u'll know it when u see it

bryan: bryan u drum like u're mad at the kit and the kit deserves it. nobody at school gets that. the garage gets it. friday. bring the anger. (greg says also bring the cymbal u left)

bulletins.subject: a poem (do not comment unless u FELT it)
bulletins.body: 'Trash Night' — they say take it out / but what if i am the one being taken out / of the conversation / of society / of dinner (i was late)(they started without me) / the bag is full / so am i. — from the black notebook, page 47. don't repost this. actually repost it everywhere.
